mentions.name: Cricket
mentions.description: A visual scripting plugin for Figma, inspired by Grasshopper for Rhino, that brings node-based algorithmic design and Grasshopper-style data modeling to 2D graphics workflows.
mentions.problem: Grasshopper, especially its data model, is well suited for algorithmic art and design, but there was no way to use that approach inside a 2D graphics package.
mentions.audience: Designers and artists doing algorithmic art and design work
mentions.source_excerpt:
Cricket, a visual scripting plugin for Figma inspired by Grasshopper for Rhino.

I find Grasshopper, especially its data model, ideal for a certain type of algorithmic art/design, and have always wanted to use it in a 2D graphics package.
